articles.summary: Support local youth with Dutch Bros! 💛 On Friday, 9/18, $1 from every drink sold on Buck for Kids Day goes directly to local non-profits. Join the giveback!
articles.title: Dutch Bros® and the Dutch Bros Foundation® Rally Customers for 20th Annual Buck for Kids Day to Support Local Youth

articles.title: Dutch Bros® Is Giving Drinks a Glow-Up with its Latest Merch Drop
